title: Stable Ender Pearl
description:
While Stable Ender Pearls are used in various crafting recipes they also have a purpose on their own.

When you you right click a stable ender pearl in your hand it will be bound to you (it is not thrown). When it's dropped on the ground it will teleport the player it's bound to to itself after 7 seconds. The whole dropped stack is used up.
If it's not bound to anyone it will instead teleport a random living entity in a 10 block radius to itself.

properties.label: Unbound Behavior
properties.value: Teleports a random entity within 10 blocks
